name: Solve M.E. 2026 Community Address: Shaping What Comes Next
dates: Tuesday 20 October 2026, 1pm PT / 4pm ET (Wednesday 21 October, 7am AEDT)
patient_access: Free and open to everyone. Registration required.
notes: Solve M.E. usually posts webinar recordings on its website and YouTube.

name: RECOVER-TLC Third Annual Workshop
organiser: NIH RECOVER-TLC / Foundation for the NIH
patient_access: Online or in person. Includes input from people with lived experience.
notes: Updates on the NIH Long COVID treatment trials, several of which are relevant to ME/CFS.

name: SIGNAL Study webinar: home-based treatments in ME/CFS and Long COVID research
patient_access: Free. Registration required.

name: 4th Long COVID International Conference
patient_access: Aimed at clinicians and researchers, with some community representatives. Paid.

name: International ME/CFS Awareness Day 2027
dates: Wednesday 12 May 2027, with awareness week events around it
organiser: Emerge Australia, May12th.org.au, ME/CFS Australia, #MEAction and others
patient_access: Free. Includes landmark "Light Up The Night" lighting and #MillionsMissing actions you can join from home.
notes: The 2027 programme hasn't been announced yet. In 2026, Emerge Australia ran an online symposium during awareness week.

name: International ME Conference Week 2027 (IIMEC19)
location: UK (venue to be confirmed; recent years at the Wellcome Genome Campus near Cambridge)
patient_access: The IIMEC conference is open to the public and clinicians. Past talks were published free online afterwards.
notes: Includes a research colloquium (researchers only) and a young researchers' event.

name: Dysautonomia International 15th Annual Conference
patient_access: Designed for patients, with patient, caregiver and teen programmes. Paid. Registration not yet open.
notes: Focused on POTS and dysautonomia, which are very common alongside ME/CFS.

name: Severe ME Day 2027
patient_access: A day to remember and raise awareness of people with severe and very severe ME/CFS.

name: International ME/CFS Conference 2027 (Berlin)
dates: Expected May 2027; exact date to be announced towards the end of 2026
organiser: Charité Fatigue Centrum & ME/CFS Research Foundation
patient_access: In past years: free online attendance, a German-language patient symposium, and free videos afterwards.
notes: The organiser says the 2027 date will be announced towards the end of 2026. This is the field's largest meeting; 2026 had more than 7,300 participants.

name: Stanford / OMF Community Symposium on the Molecular Basis of ME/CFS 2027
dates: Usually held in September. Date to be announced.
organiser: Stanford ME/CFS Collaborative Research Center / Open Medicine Foundation
patient_access: Free with registration in past years.

name: PRIME International Symposium
organiser: PRIME (University of Edinburgh / Action for ME)
patient_access: People with lived experience were invited, with an online option.

name: 10th Stanford Community Symposium on the Molecular Basis of ME/CFS
patient_access: Free.
notes: OMF says the recording will be posted to its YouTube channel.

name: ME Group Australia: Severe ME Month webinar
patient_access: Free. Videos are linked from the event page.

name: ISLC-PAIS Conference 2026
organiser: International Society for Long COVID & Post-Acute Infection Syndromes
patient_access: Professional audience. Paid video on demand.

name: Dysautonomia International 14th Annual Conference
patient_access: Designed for patients.

name: International ME Conference Week 2026 (IIMEC18)
patient_access: **IIMEC18 videos are free online.**

name: Emerge Australia ME/CFS Awareness Week 2026: "The Hidden Harm of Trying Harder"
dates: 11–17 May 2026, including a symposium on 12 May
patient_access: Free. **Symposium audio and podcast episodes are on the event page.** The theme was post-exertional malaise.

name: International ME/CFS Conference 2026 (Berlin)
organiser: Charité Fatigue Centrum & ME/CFS Research Foundation
patient_access: **Free videos** with English slides and subtitles.
notes: Included the Canadian LDN trial results and DecodeME. See [2026 results](/research/results/).

name: Solve M.E. webinar series 2026
patient_access: Free recordings, including a talk from Prof Carmen Scheibenbogen (Charité).

name: Long COVID Conference 2026 (CRE-PAVING)
dates: 1–2 October 2026 (workshop on 1 October, conference on 2 October)
audience: Researchers, clinicians, allied health and people with lived experience
organiser: CRE-PAVING (NHMRC Centre of Research Excellence in post-acute viral illness)
patient_access: Registration through the conference website. Enquiries and accessibility support: Longcovid2026@latrobe.edu.au.
notes: Focus: from discovery to evidence-based treatments for Long COVID.

name: Emerge Australia live pop-up: Pacing upright hours (OI/POTS)
patient_access: Free. Not recorded, to protect participants' privacy.
notes: Run by an Emerge support nurse.

name: Emerge Australia Q&A session with MissingSchool
patient_access: Free. Not recorded.
notes: For families of children and teenagers with ME/CFS or Long COVID who are missing school. See [ME/CFS in children](/understanding/children/).

name: Emerge Australia: Disability Support Pension Q&A
patient_access: Free. Australia only. Not recorded.

name: International Long Covid Awareness Day 2027
patient_access: Held every year on 15 March.
